::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The Xiamen campus of Silan — China's flagship private power-semi IDM — stacks a 12-inch silicon power fab (¥7 billion first line, in production since December 2020, 2025 output 637,400 wafers) alongside a 6-inch SiC line; two further lines are now in motion at the same campus: the ¥12 billion 8-inch SiC fab (士兰集宏) and ¥20 billion 12-inch high-end analog fab (士兰集华). Investment figure tracked here is the Jike 12-inch project total (¥7bn phase 1 + ¥5bn/¥2bn expansions ≈¥15bn of the ¥17bn two-line plan); the newer phases are covered in milestones.
:::

**Chinese name:** 厦门士兰集科微电子有限公司 / 厦门士兰明镓化合物半导体有限公司 (Shìmén Shìlán Jíkē / Míngjiā)

## What does this facility make?

IGBT/MOSFET power chips for EV main drives, PV and industrial IPM modules; SiC devices; MEMS sensors.

## Why does it matter?

IPM modules exceeding 250 million units shipped in 2025 (+47%) show a Chinese IDM supplying white goods and cars from wafer up; the January 2026 dual event (集宏 8-inch SiC line-out ceremony + 集华 12-inch analog groundbreaking, reported as China's first fully self-IP 8-inch SiC power line) extends the same campus into the two most strategic specialty segments.

## Project Timeline

- **Dec 2020** — Jike 12-inch power line formally enters production (90nm, phase 1 40,000 wafers/month)
- **May 2024** — ¥12 billion 8-inch SiC project (士兰集宏) signed with Xiamen city
- **Oct 2025** — ¥20 billion 12-inch high-end analog project (士兰集华) signed (phase 1 ¥10 billion, 45,000 wafers/month planned)
- **Jan 2026** — 集宏 8-inch SiC line-out ceremony (trial production since Nov 2025) + 集华 12-inch groundbreaking, same day
